scope: Read-only aggregate host samples during the direct BenchmarkTool command; no SwiftPM parent or build phase. CPU busy uses /proc/stat user/nice/system/irq/softirq/steal, excludes idle/iowait and duplicate guest counters; average is across all logical CPUs and all processes. CPU0 frequency and thermal-zone snapshots do not prove absence of throttling or isolate benchmark process costs.
